Mental health staffing

Staff who stay calm when a shift gets hard.

Mental health services need people with the right training and the right temperament. We supply RMN nurses, mental health healthcare assistants and support workers for inpatient, rehabilitation and community services.

Request Staff 020 3488 8172

Settings

  • Mental health hospitals and wards
  • Locked and step-down rehabilitation
  • Community and crisis services
  • Dementia and older adult mental health units

Included

  • RMN nurses
  • Mental health healthcare assistants and support workers
  • Staff for enhanced observations, on request
  • Days, nights, single shifts and block bookings

Not included

  • Psychiatrists, psychologists and approved mental health professionals
  • Physical intervention by anyone not trained in your approved method
  • Secure transport or escort services

Training our mental health staff hold

  • De-escalation
  • Enhanced observations
  • Safeguarding adults
  • Mental Health Act awareness
How it works

Booking mental health staff.

  1. Tell us the ward or service

    Patient group, observation levels and any training your policies require.

  2. Agree terms

    Rates and booking rules in writing.

  3. We match on training

    Only staff with the training you require are offered.

  4. You know who is coming

    Name and arrival time before the shift.

Cost and timing

What affects mental health cover.

RMN availability

RMNs are among the hardest nurses to find. Book ahead where you can.

Training required

A specific physical intervention method narrows the pool of staff.

Observation level

One-to-one and two-to-one observations need more staff hours.

Questions

Mental health staffing questions.

Can you staff enhanced observations?

Tell us the observation level, the hours and the training your policy requires. We will tell you what we can cover.

Do your staff hold restraint training?

Training differs between services. Tell us the method your service uses and we will only offer staff who hold it.
